title: Vega Assault
summary: Five mecha missions with Special Cosmo assembly, lunar transformations, NPC Spazer support and an animated escape finale.
description: Launch from a hidden base and defend Earth. Fly Double Spazer in the sky, Marine Spazer underwater and Drill Spazer underground. Assemble Special Cosmo and launch to the Moon, where Grendizer cycles between Spazer, Robot and combined forms with three NPC escorts. Destroy the Vega Moon base and watch the animated flight home. Original pixel art and stereo chiptune/SFX. Unofficial non-commercial educational fan work; no ripped artwork or recordings.
